data.narrative:
Bedrock Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Joselyn Lai, Silviu Livescu, and Joel Wishkovsky, having raised $15M+ to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lanza Technologies, LNZA), though no private peers exist at identical stage and valuation tier, limiting traditional multiples-based approaches.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology applies: using the $15M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-round progression yields $30M. This represents the only analytically sound triangulation point; peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within narrow filtering criteria. The broader peer universe—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—is heterogeneous across stage and technology, making direct multiple extrapolation unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. Primary uncertainties include the absence of close-stage peer comps, reliance on a single methodological leg, and the early-stage nature of the company, which typically carries higher dispersion in valuation outcomes. Additional rounds of external financing or operational milestones would provide more robust anchoring points for future assessments.
